svg.text: OBJECT KEY · room and puzzle order
T target · V visual-only · F foreground
3 T · Tsalohi goat bell and strap
6 T · Chicken coop and transport catch
Kofi: 224 art px / 112 logical units. Background stays fixed; props and stages are independent.
Click a stage to view one snapshot; All shows alternative footprints, not a simultaneous scene.
evening: Ordinary errands; all neighbours alive; gate pin and bell change during chores.
warning: Chores complete; actor reactions and a separate rattling cup precede the crack.
collapse: Ground cracks, coop opened for escape, equipment collected; normal exploration is replaced by the
rescue: Intact ground hides; central footing and two ledges show. Both candidates visible until the explicit
choice. Hide the unsaved ledge and its actor together; the survivor crosses the footing.
departure: Hide collapsing near buildings, ground and props with their supporting ledge; keep inland gate and
stable exit readable until the fade.
